1: // Endless runner (Canvas Runner) – concise implementation
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> is present in the page.
3: 
4: window.addEventListener('load', () => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
9: 
10:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
11:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
12:   const SPEED = 4; // scroll speed (px/frame)
13:   const GROUND_Y = HEIGHT - 30; // platform height
14: 
15:   const player = {x: 50, y: GROUND_Y - 20, w: 20, h: 20, vy: 0, onGround: true};
16:   let platforms = [{x: 0, w: WIDTH, y: GROUND_Y}]; // start with full ground
17:   let obstacles = [];
18:   let frame = 0;
19:   let score = 0;
20:   let gameOver = false;
21: 
22:   const keys = {};
23:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys[e.code] = true; });
24:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') keys[e.code] = false; });
25: 
26:   function spawnSegment() {
27:     // Randomly create a gap or obstacle on the next segment
28:     const segWidth = 120 + Math.random() * 80; // 120‑200px segment
29:     const gap = Math.random() < 0.2; // 20% chance to have a gap
30:     const lastX = platforms.length ? platforms[platforms.length - 1].x + platforms[platforms.length - 1].w : WIDTH;
31:     if (gap) {
32:       // add empty space (no platform) – player will fall if not timed
33:       platforms.push({x: lastX + segWidth, w: segWidth, y: GROUND_Y});
34:     } else {
35:       platforms.push({x: lastX, w: segWidth, y: GROUND_Y});
36:     }
37:     // Occasionally add an obstacle on the platform
38:     if (!gap && Math.random() < 0.3) {
39:       const obsW = 15, obsH = 30;
40:       const obsX = lastX + segWidth / 2 - obsW / 2;
41:       obstacles.push({x: obsX, y: GROUND_Y - obsH, w: obsW, h: obsH});
42:     }
43:   }
44: 
45:   function update() {
46:     if (gameOver) return;
47:     // Input
48:     if ((keys['Space'] || keys['ArrowUp']) && player.onGround) {
49:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
50:       player.onGround = false;
51:     }
52:     // Physics
53:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
54:     player.y += player.vy;
55:     // Simple ground check against platforms under player
56:     player.onGround = false;
57:     for (const p of platforms) {
58:       if (player.x + player.w > p.x && player.x < p.x + p.w) {
59:         const platformTop = p.y;
60:         if (player.y + player.h >= platformTop && player.y + player.h - player.vy < platformTop) {
61:           player.y = platformTop - player.h;
62:           player.vy = 0;
63:           player.onGround = true;
64:         }
65:       }
66:     }
67:     // Fall off screen = lose
68:     if (player.y > HEIGHT) gameOver = true;
69:     // Move world left
70:     for (const p of platforms) p.x -= SPEED;
71:     for (const o of obstacles) o.x -= SPEED;
72:     // Remove off‑screen entities
73:     platforms = platforms.filter(p => p.x + p.w > 0);
74:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
75:     // Spawn new terrain as needed
76:     if (platforms.length === 0 || platforms[platforms.length - 1].x + platforms[platforms.length - 1].w < WIDTH) {
77:       spawnSegment();
78:     }
79:     // Collision with obstacles
80:     for (const o of obstacles) {
81:       const coll = player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
82:                    player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y;
83:       if (coll) { gameOver = true; break; }
84:     }
85:     // Score based on distance
86:     score = Math.floor(frame / 60);
87:     frame++;
88:   }
89: 
90:   function draw() {
91:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
92:     // Draw platforms
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
94:     for (const p of platforms) ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, HEIGHT - p.y);
95:     // Draw obstacles
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#c33';
97:     for (const o of obstacles) ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
98:     // Draw player
99:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0';
100:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
101:     // UI
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
103:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
104:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
105:     if (gameOver) {
106:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
107:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,WIDTH,HEIGHT);
108:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
110:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH/2-70, HEIGHT/2);
111:     }
112:   }
113: 
114:   function loop() {
115:     update();
116:     draw();
117:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
118:   }
119: 
120:   // Kick off
121:   spawnSegment(); // initial extra segment
122:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
123: });

(End of file - total 123 lines)
</content>
